Hi Tara — thanks for the SOC2 (appreciate the quick turnaround). We can do a bounded inspection approach; that aligns with Redwood's standard exhibit for customers who want minimal blast radius. High-level proposal below (happy to iterate):

- Scope: platform-level inspection limited to (a) access logs, (b) config snapshots, (c) connectivity diagrams, and (d) scoped ephemeral staging access to a representative test environment. No production forensic access without prior escalation.
- Pen-test cadence: Redwood can support Dec 15-19 for the active window. We recommend a short canary phase (1 day) followed by the main 3-day test and a 1-day follow-up for findings validation.
- Evidence cadence: we can provide three artifact deliveries — (1) pre-test artifact bundle (network diagrams, SOC2 attestation), (2) mid-test rolling logs (daily), (3) final summary & sample artifacts (post-test). This keeps your team from waiting for a single large drop.

I've attached a draft security exhibit with the bounded inspection language proposed: Redwood_Draft_Security_Exhibit_MedAlign_v1.docx.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, can procurement countersign PO-5472 via the DocuSign link and let us know the final signature ETA?
2) Tara — confirm the technical POC for staging access (name + email) and any blackout dates for Dec 15-19.

I'll leave Kar@ and Marissa on for legal & ops redlines — they'll follow up on precise notice windows and indemnity language.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference

Subject: [INTERNAL] Redlines for MedAlign security exhibit (PO-5472)

PRIYA / MARISSA — internal thoughts and redline asks before we send the updated exhibit to MedAlign: 

- Accept bounded inspection, but we should explicitly limit scope to non-production snapshots and representative test data. Add language: "No direct access to customer PII or production instance unless mutually agreed following a high-severity incident."
- Notice window: 10 business days for scheduled inspections; 48 hours for low-risk maintenance requests. This provides an operability buffer. MedAlign asked for shorter notice; propose 10 bd to be safe.
- Pen-test access: require ephemeral creds that expire automatically (48-72 hours) and audit trail export (read-only). No SSH bastion or root-level login without escalation.
- Evidence cadence: prefer the three-delivery model Priya proposed; add that final deliverable will include a remediation plan template and action owners for any high/critical findings.
- Indemnity: add a short carveout to limit our liability for third-party tools used by MedAlign in their staging environment.

If you both agree, I'll draft the precise redline markup and push the exhibit back to Tara with a short cover note. We should also record the changes in HubSpot (deal 57321).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

1) Bounded inspection: limited to non-prod snapshots, access logs, connectivity diagrams, and ephemeral test environment access. Clause added: "No production customer data access without explicit written escalation and scope agreement."
